buyer: controller or CFO of a multi-location operator
workflow: browser-local synthetic invoice and purchase order
durable idempotency key for one workflow
exactly one synthetic controller approval request for an accepted matched fixture
timestamped crash, retry, rollback, and final decision receipts
copyable JSON and Markdown binary report
acceptance: the same input produces the same decision
a duplicate replay creates no second approval request
a crash after durable intent can retry to exactly one approval request
a crash after durable intent can roll back before any approval request
missing or mismatched data fails before effect
every run emits a copyable JSON and Markdown receipt
the diagnostic uses synthetic or non-confidential workflow details only
payment execution, bank connection, credential collection, vendor-master change, tax advice, and approval authority remain zero

commercial.refund: If the accepted diagnostic is not delivered inside the one-business-day window, the paid diagnostic amount is refunded unless the buyer elects in writing to receive one free next-business-day repair instead.

data_boundary: browser-local synthetic or non-confidential fixtures only; no upload; no telemetry; no server submission
decision_boundary: invoice/PO matching and approval-packet preparation only; never payment execution, bank connection, credential collection, vendor-master change, tax advice, or approval authority
